_why: Module 3 lab checks (labs/m3/checks.json), REAL. Run at the lab's end state: after "Commit the design documents" and before "Teardown", so the cluster still exists for the first check.

The first check reads object state from the cluster; every kubectl sets KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" and --context kind-grid-core itself. The rest read the three documents the learner wrote, by section and by cell content, never by heading alone; an absent file or section prints a zero count and fails its anchored match.
Paths are relative to the learner tree (the labs repo root). In src run it from labs/ with: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m3/checks.json).

The operator-category MUST is named by its course label, ai-operator, never by its upstream id (research Pitfall 1). A pass here proves what the learner recorded, never that the cluster or the platform is conformant.

checks.describe: the cluster serves resourceslices.resource.k8s.io and holds zero ResourceSlices: the DRA API is there and no driver publishes a device, the headline gap. An unreachable cluster prints served=unread
checks.run:
r=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core api-resources --api-group=resource.k8s.io -o name 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] || { echo 'served=unread slices=unread'; exit 0; }; case "$r" in *resourceslices.resource.k8s.io*) a=yes;; *) a=no;; esac; l=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core get resourceslices -o name 2>/dev/null) || { printf 'served=%s slices=unread
' "$a"; exit 0; }; n=$(printf '%s
' "$l" | grep -c '^resourceslice'); printf 'served=%s slices=%s
' "$a" "$n"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/kar-gap-report.md, section ## Requirements: 15 data rows whose Item cells are the 15 course labels, each exactly once. An absent file or section prints items=0
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/kar-gap-report.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'items=0 distinct=0 unknown=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} BEGIN{n=split("accelerator-driver-runtime accelerator-sharing virtualized-accelerator inference-gateway inference-extension-routing high-performance-networking disaggregated-inference gang-scheduling cluster-autoscaling pod-autoscaling accelerator-metrics ai-service-metrics secure-accelerator-access workload-sandboxing ai-operator",L," "); for(i=1;i<=n;i++) ok[L[i]]=1} /^## Requirements[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Item *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{c++; x=t($2); if(x in ok){if(!(x in seen)){seen[x]=1;d++}} else u++} END{printf "items=%d distinct=%d unknown=%d\n", c, d, u}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/kar-gap-report.md, section ## Requirements: every Verdict cell is exactly one of verifiable here, not verifiable on this cluster, not applicable, bare. An absent file prints rows=0
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/kar-gap-report.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 bad=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} /^## Requirements[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Item *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{r++; v=w($5); if(v!="verifiable here"&&v!="not verifiable on this cluster"&&v!="not applicable") b++} END{printf "rows=%d bad=%d\n", r, b}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/kar-gap-report.md, section ## Headline: the headline gap sentence, matched as a fixed string on one line
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/kar-gap-report.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'headline=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -v h='resource.k8s.io/v1 is served, but no driver publishes a ResourceSlice: no device can be requested by attribute yet. Module 4 closes this.' '/^## Headline[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s{l=$0; sub(/[ \t]+$/,"",l); if(l==h) p=1} END{print (p ? "headline=present" : "headline=absent")}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md, section ## Tenants: rows for `research`, `data` and `product` (code spans), each with a non-empty What it runs and Priority
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'tenants=0 file=missing'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} /^## Tenants[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Tenant *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{x=w($2); if((x=="`research`"||x=="`data`"||x=="`product`") && w($3)!="" && w($4)!="" && !(x in seen)){seen[x]=1;n++}} END{printf "tenants=%d\n", n}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md, section ## Workload classes: rows whose first cell is exactly Data preparation, Training and fine-tuning, Inference and Agents, each with non-empty Tenants and needs
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'classes=0 file=missing'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} /^## Workload classes[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Class *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{x=w($2); if((x=="Data preparation"||x=="Training and fine-tuning"||x=="Inference"||x=="Agents") && w($3)!="" && w($4)!="" && !(x in seen)){seen[x]=1;n++}} END{printf "classes=%d\n", n}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md, section ## Architecture by layer: the nine layer directories in code spans as first cells, and each layer's Owner cell carrying at least one code span
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'layers=0 owned=0 file=missing'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} BEGIN{n=split("nodes capacity dataplane-storage training serving routing datalayer agents observability",L," "); for(i=1;i<=n;i++) ok["`" L[i] "`"]=1} /^## Architecture by layer[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Layer *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{x=w($2); sub(/\/`$/,"`",x); if(x in ok){if(!(x in seen)){seen[x]=1;l++} if(w($4) ~ /`[^`]+`/ && !(x in own)){own[x]=1;o++}}} END{printf "layers=%d owned=%d\n", l, o}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md, section ## Decisions deferred: at least one row, and every row has a Decision and a Deferred to cell that is M4 to M13
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 bad=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} /^## Decisions deferred[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Decision *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{r++; if(w($2)=="" || w($3) !~ /^M([4-9]|1[0-3])$/) b++} END{printf "rows=%d bad=%d\n", r, b}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md, section ## Capabilities, links capacity-model.md and cost-model.md by relative path, and both of Module 2's files are present in grid-platform/docs/
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/platform-design.md; d=grid-platform/docs; if [ -f "$f" ]; then l=$(awk '/^## Capabilities[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/\]\((\.\/)?capacity-model\.md\)/{c=1} s&&/\]\((\.\/)?cost-model\.md\)/{k=1} END{printf "%s %s", (c?"linked":"unlinked"), (k?"linked":"unlinked")}' "$f"); else l='unread unread'; fi; set -- $l; [ -f "$d/capacity-model.md" ] && p1=present || p1=absent; [ -f "$d/cost-model.md" ] && p2=present || p2=absent; printf 'capacity=%s,%s cost=%s,%s\n' "$1" "$p1" "$2" "$p2"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/landscape-grading.md, section ## My grading: at least six rows, each with an Entry and with Maturity, Recommendation and Evidence grade cells each a bare word from its vocabulary
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/landscape-grading.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 bad=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} /^## My grading[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Entry *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{r++; m=w($3); c=w($4); e=w($5); if(w($2)=="") b++; if(m!="shipped-and-stable"&&m!="shipped-and-immature"&&m!="announced-or-roadmap") b++; if(c!="bet-on-it"&&c!="pilot-it"&&c!="read-it-fluently") b++; if(e!="verified"&&e!="cited"&&e!="unverified") b++} END{printf "rows=%d bad=%d\n", r, b}' "$f"

checks.describe: grid-platform/docs/landscape-grading.md, section ## My grading: every row has an https:// URL in Source and a YYYY-MM-DD date in Read on
checks.run: f=grid-platform/docs/landscape-grading.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 undated=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'function w(s){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",s);return s} function t(s){gsub(/^[ \t`]+|[ \t`]+$/,"",s);return s} /^## My grading[ \t]*$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s&&/^\| *Entry *\|/{next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&/^\|/{r++; if(w($6) !~ /^https:\/\/[^ ]+$/ || w($7) !~ /^20[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]$/) u++} END{printf "rows=%d undated=%d\n", r, u}' "$f"
